KDDI outlines ELYZA Robotics and a ¥30 billion R&D plan through FY2030

The company was formed October 1; the newly announced Physical AI program targets more than 1,000 deployed robots.

KDDI ↗27 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 2

Formation and long-term targets

KDDI and ELYZA disclosed on October 27 that ELYZA Robotics was established October 1. The group targets roughly ¥30 billion in R&D through FY2030 and an organization of over 300 specialists. The investment target differs from the new company’s stated ¥100 million capital.

Data, models and operations

The approach combines vision-language and robot-action models, egocentric data and simulation with KDDI compute and communications. Plans cover both a research/data foundation and an operating platform for distributed inference, remote monitoring and coordination across robots.

Partner-based demonstrations

KDDI targets more than 1,000 robot deployments by FY2030, beginning proofs of concept in 2026. Applications include replenishment, transport and manufacturing with partners such as Lawson and group companies. Robot counts and business outcomes remain targets rather than completed deployments.
